class FlightDateStatusAvailable(BaseModel):

    prices: dict[dm.CabinClass, int] = Field(description='Current prices by class')
    seats_available: dict[dm.CabinClass, int] = Field(description='Available seats for different cabin classes')

dm.FlightDateStatusAvailable = FlightDateStatusAvailable

dm.FlightDateStatus = (

    | dm.FlightDataStatusFlying
    | dm.FlightDateStatusLanded
    | dm.FlightDateStatusCancelled
    | dm.FlightDateStatusDelayed
)

# Rebuild Flight model with updated FlightDateStatus
class Flight(dm.FlightBase):
    dates: dict[str, dm.FlightDateStatus] = Field(default_factory=dict, description='Flight dates and their statuses')

dm.Flight = Flight

# Rebuild FlightDB with updated Flight
class FlightDB(dm.DB):
    flights: dict[str, Flight] = Field(default_factory=dict, description='Dictionary of all flights indexed by flight number')
    users: dict[str, dm.User] = Field(default_factory=dict, description='Dictionary of all users indexed by user ID')

# Copy the load and save classmethods
